## 87:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-to-Zion it-will-be-said, 'Man and-man was-born in-her,' and-he the-Most-High will-establish-her.
- **LOGOS:** And of Zion it shall be said, "This one and that one were born in her"; for the Most High himself will establish her.
- **PNEUMA:** And of Zion it will be said, 'People from every nation were born here!' The Most High himself will make her strong.
